propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stdlib argparse.HelpFormatter instead of version-pinned RebarHelpFormatter, creating a py3.13 help-generation staleness trap identical to RP-05 S2d regressions.
Committed help artifacts show width inconsistency: bridge.txt (RebarHelpFormatter, width-80) differs from bridge-fsck.txt (stock HelpFormatter, width-78) despite being the same command family.

Any of the four affected factories gaining a short+long metavar option or usage wrapping change under py3.13 would silently stale gen_cli_help.py --check and docs reference --check on py3.13 only, reintroducing the S2d failure mode.
Contract test must enforce that all help-backed (rendered) registered route factories use only RebarHelpFormatter subclasses to prevent future regression.
